# `@ashstack/legend-list`

_auto-enabled when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency._

- [`required-props`](#ashstacklegend-listrequired-props)
- [`no-index-key-extractor`](#ashstacklegend-listno-index-key-extractor)
- [`no-remount-key`](#ashstacklegend-listno-remount-key)
- [`no-inline-render-item-props`](#ashstacklegend-listno-inline-render-item-props)
- [`no-mixed-children`](#ashstacklegend-listno-mixed-children)
- [`no-flex-in-content-container`](#ashstacklegend-listno-flex-in-content-container)
- [`typed-items-need-item-type`](#ashstacklegend-listtyped-items-need-item-type)
- [`no-scrollview-map`](#ashstacklegend-listno-scrollview-map)
- [`no-unsupported-props`](#ashstacklegend-listno-unsupported-props)

**Import bans that ship with this module**

- `FlatList`, `SectionList`, `VirtualizedList` from `react-native`
- `*` from `@shopify/flash-list`
- any import of `@legendapp/list`

## `@ashstack/legend-list/required-props`

Require `keyExtractor` and an explicit `recycleItems` on a Legend List. Without a key extractor the list keys its rows by index.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

// keyExtractor and recycleItems are both missing.
export const Bad = () => <LegendList data={items} renderItem={renderRow} />;
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Good = () => (
  <LegendList data={items} renderItem={renderRow} keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems />
);

// An explicit opt-out is a decision, not a violation.
export const NoRecycle = () => (
  <LegendList data={items} renderItem={renderRow} keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems={false} />
);
```

## `@ashstack/legend-list/no-index-key-extractor`

Disallow a `keyExtractor` that uses its index parameter. Cached sizes and recycled row state hang off the key, so a prepend points every measurement at the wrong item.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Bad = () => (
  <LegendList
    data={items}
    renderItem={renderRow}
    keyExtractor={(item, index) => String(index)}
    recycleItems
  />
);
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Good = () => (
  <LegendList data={items} renderItem={renderRow} keyExtractor={item => item.id} recycleItems />
);
```

## `@ashstack/legend-list/no-remount-key`

Disallow `key` on a Legend List, which remounts on any key change and loses its measurements and scroll position. Pass `dataKey` instead.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const activeTab: string;
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Bad = () => (
  <LegendList key={activeTab} data={items} renderItem={renderRow} keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems />
);
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const activeTab: string;
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Good = () => (
  <LegendList dataKey={activeTab} data={items} renderItem={renderRow} keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems />
);
```

## `@ashstack/legend-list/no-inline-render-item-props`

Disallow inline object and array literals on props nested inside `renderItem`. A row whose props take a new identity every render can never be skipped.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string }; style?: unknown }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;

export const Bad = () => (
  <LegendList
    data={items}
    renderItem={({ item }) => <Row item={item} style={{ paddingVertical: 8 }} />}
    keyExtractor={keyOf}
    recycleItems
  />
);
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string }; gap?: number }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;

export const Good = () => (
  <LegendList
    data={items}
    renderItem={({ item }) => <Row item={item} gap={8} />}
    keyExtractor={keyOf}
    recycleItems
  />
);
```

## `@ashstack/legend-list/no-mixed-children`

Disallow passing both `data` and real children to a Legend List. The combination is unsupported and one of the two is dropped without a warning.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
declare const Footer: () => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Bad = () => (
  <LegendList data={items} renderItem={renderRow} keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems>
    <Footer />
  </LegendList>
);
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
declare const Footer: () => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

// data mode
export const DataMode = () => (
  <LegendList data={items} renderItem={renderRow} keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems />
);

// children mode
export const ChildrenMode = () => (
  <LegendList keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems>
    <Footer />
  </LegendList>
);
```

## `@ashstack/legend-list/no-flex-in-content-container`

Disallow `flex` in a Legend List's `contentContainerStyle`, where it sizes the scrolled content to the viewport and the list ends up measuring zero height.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";
import { StyleSheet } from "react-native-unistyles";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Bad = () => (
  <LegendList
    data={items}
    renderItem={renderRow}
    keyExtractor={keyOf}
    recycleItems
    contentContainerStyle={styles.stretched}
  />
);

const styles = StyleSheet.create(theme => {
  if (theme.dark) return { stretched: { flex: 1 } };
  return { stretched: { padding: theme.gap } };
});
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";
import { StyleSheet } from "react-native-unistyles";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Good = () => (
  <LegendList
    data={items}
    renderItem={renderRow}
    keyExtractor={keyOf}
    recycleItems
    style={styles.fill}
    contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
  />
);

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  fill: { flex: 1 },
  content: { paddingBottom: 24 },
});
```

## `@ashstack/legend-list/typed-items-need-item-type`

Require `getItemType` when a row branches on `item.type`. Without it every layout shares one recycling pool and one size average.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string; type: "header" | "photo" }[];
declare const Header: () => JSX.Element;
declare const Photo: () => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderMixed = ({ item }: { item: { type: string } }) =>
  item.type === "header" ? <Header /> : <Photo />;

export const Bad = () => (
  <LegendList data={items} renderItem={renderMixed} keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems />
);
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string; type: "header" | "photo" }[];
declare const Header: () => JSX.Element;
declare const Photo: () => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderMixed = ({ item }: { item: { type: string } }) =>
  item.type === "header" ? <Header /> : <Photo />;

export const Good = () => (
  <LegendList
    data={items}
    renderItem={renderMixed}
    keyExtractor={keyOf}
    recycleItems
    getItemType={item => item.type}
  />
);
```

## `@ashstack/legend-list/no-scrollview-map`

A `ScrollView` mounts every child up front, so a mapped collection does not belong in its children.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { ScrollView } from "react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;

export const Bad = () => (
  <ScrollView>
    {items.map(item => (
      <Row key={item.id} item={item} />
    ))}
  </ScrollView>
);
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { ScrollView } from "react-native";

declare const Header: () => JSX.Element;
declare const Footer: () => JSX.Element;

// A handful of static children is what a ScrollView is for.
export const Good = () => (
  <ScrollView>
    <Header />
    <Footer />
  </ScrollView>
);
```

## `@ashstack/legend-list/no-unsupported-props`

Disallow FlashList and FlatList props that Legend List v3 does not have. It ignores them rather than rejecting them, so the feature looks broken.

**Default: on**, when `@legendapp/list` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Bad = () => (
  <LegendList data={items} renderItem={renderRow} keyExtractor={keyOf} recycleItems inverted masonry />
);
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { LegendList } from "@legendapp/list/react-native";

declare const items: { id: string }[];
declare const Row: (props: { item: { id: string } }) => JSX.Element;
const keyOf = (item: { id: string }) => item.id;
const renderRow = ({ item }: { item: { id: string } }) => <Row item={item} />;

export const Good = () => (
  <LegendList
    data={items}
    renderItem={renderRow}
    keyExtractor={keyOf}
    recycleItems
    maintainScrollAtEnd
    initialScrollAtEnd
  />
);
```
